slate_notes: Saturday Nov 21: NBA (6 games) + NHL (14 games). No NFL today; Saturday isn't an NFL slate day under the slate rule. Priced assists + rebounds for all 6 NBA games and SOG for 9 NHL games with pl price (21 credits; per-book devig median, 2+ books, unders shaded -3 pts), then checked each against ESPN L10 game logs and injury reports. 11 legs in 11 different games: 10 overs and 1 under (DJJ U1.5 ast, a volume under). Skipped: Cissoko O1.5 ast (5/10 L10 vs 60.8% price), Cam Spencer O2.5 reb (3/10 L10), Embiid O3.5 ast (4/10), Batherson/Pinto O1.5 SOG (5/10), Hischier U2.5 SOG (NJ's Mantha ruled out Nov 17, a role-expansion flag), Tavares U2.5 (TOR Marchenko IR Nov 20), Benson U2.5 (L10 contradicts), Fiala U2.5 (only 4 games of data), Sabonis O4.5 ast (cooldown, missed Nov 20), and K. Dunn O2.5 ast / Hachimura O4.5 reb (same game as the DJJ leg). Cooldown: no conflicts. Back-to-backs flagged: NO and SAC (both played Nov 20). Simons is a 1:10 PM tip and Maxey is Q, so recheck at finalize. Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.

legs.reasoning: Simons has 2 assists in 6 of his last 10, including 3 of the last 4. His minutes jumped to 38 at ORL on Nov 18 with the PHI guard room thin: Jaylen Brown (hamstring) and Dean Wade are out, and Maxey (foot) is questionable. If Maxey sits, Simons gets more on-ball time, which pushes this up. The 5-book median is 60.9% with tight agreement (-175 to -190). The risk is the low ceiling (he never tops 2 in the L10), so it's a volume-and-minutes over, not a role-upside bet. Matinee tip at 1:10 PM ET.
